title: Satchel: Inventory Manager
description: A roomy inventory manager for D&D 5e characters with big bags: herbs, reagents, monster parts, ore and every other thing a crafter hoards. Opens from a button on any character sheet. Automatic categories, search and tags, quick quantity changes, one-click stack merging, bulk moves into containers, giving items to other characters or the party stash, weight and value totals, and a GM dialog for handing out gathered materials.
